description.value:
Your sheer presence unsettles those who would manipulate you. Increase your Charisma score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

You may use your Charisma modifier in place of your Wisdom modifier for Insight checks. In addition, a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, you may substitute a Charisma saving throw for a Wisdom saving throw you are required to make. You regain all expended uses after a long rest.
